evidence: Task schema now models exact writes, reads, resources, dependencies, executable acceptance commands, expected evidence, and forbidden evidence
Writer roles require a planning-only first turn and explicit APPROVE_EXECUTION follow-up
The scheduler defaults to serial writers, caps isolated writers at two, and serializes file, resource, dependency, unknown-resource, and no-isolation conflicts
Scope gates compare actual Git changes with per-task and combined plan allowlists
Phase 5 now consumes plan approval, scope gate, and diff evidence
residualRisks: Git worktrees isolate repository files and indexes, not external services or files outside the worktree; plans must declare those shared resources
